description.value: You've learned to push scavenged tech past its rated limits, at a little risk. You can push a device, weapon, or augment 1 step past its normal performance ceiling for 1 minute; afterward it's broken until repaired unless you succeed at a Crafting check against its level DC.

cinderfall.incomplete: Temporarily pushing a device/weapon/augment past its normal performance ceiling, then having it become broken unless repaired, is a custom subsystem interaction with no rule-element representation.
